Triage: lands in `domain:ui` · `pm:queue` (from `pm:retriage`); rationale: area:ux · Bug · when a field group draws `owner_id`, the record page shows the owner twice (header meta line and the group field), against #28868 「owner once」; on `main` today; topic #35590 → p2 (UX rule) · size S (the claimant picks the single place, e.g. the meta line skips the owner when a group draws it).

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Correction to this card's body · 2026-11-20T23:44Z · A read of main `7de1bad5` found the facts below. The body was wrong in two places.

- **It is the meta line at the foot of the details column, not the header.** It is `RecordMetaFooter.tsx:273` (the decision) and `:312-315` (the render), and it is read-only. It is mounted at `RecordDetailView.tsx:5881` and shows on the default page only.
- **The scope is wider than "a group draws `owner_id`".** `owner_id` is not on the system-hidden list (`packages/spec/src/data/field-group-layout.ts:122`). Without declared groups it goes into the auto-derived group (`recordDetailSections.ts:292-293`). With declared groups that leave it out, it goes into the "other" group (`field-group-layout.ts:255`). So almost every default page of an object with an owner shows it twice. Acceptance item 2 ("groups without `owner_id` still show the owner in the meta line") is wrong for today's code.
- **#28868's "owner once" dedupes only against the key-field strip** (`RecordMetaFooter.tsx:266-272`). Since #35938 the default page draws no strip, so that rule no longer fires.
- The body field is the only place the owner can be changed (it takes the transfer permission, `DetailSection.tsx:566`).

The open fork, where the owner shows, is with the maintainer on a decision card. The seat recommends that the footer line skips the owner when the body actually draws `owner_id`: visible, not hidden, not in a collapsed group, not on another tab. The acceptance is rewritten once the maintainer rules.
